:::{#exm-mutual-information-chain-rule-copies}
#### Chain rule for mutual information along a chain of noisy copies
<!-- no-figure: the example reports a handful of numbers, with nothing to plot -->

For the chain in @exm-entropy-chain-rule-n-copies,
the marginal distribution of $X_3$ is a fair coin, so $\entropyf{X_3} = 1$ bit. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
The chunk computes the [mutual information](#def-mutual-information) of $X_3$ with $X_2$,
and with the pair $(X_1, X_2)$.

```{r}
#| code-fold: show
flip <- 0.2
h_coin <- -flip * log2(flip) - (1 - flip) * log2(1 - flip)
h_x3_given_x1_x2 <- h_coin
i_x2_x3 <- 1 - h_coin
i_x1_x2_x3 <- 1 - h_x3_given_x1_x2
c(i_x2_x3 = i_x2_x3, i_x1_x2_x3 = i_x1_x2_x3)
```

Here $I(X_2; X_3) = `r round(i_x2_x3, 3)`$ bits <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
and $I(X_1, X_2; X_3) = `r round(i_x1_x2_x3, 3)`$ bits.
The difference is $I(X_1; X_3 \mid X_2) = 0$ (@thm-mutual-information-chain-rule), <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
as in @exm-conditional-mutual-information.

:::
